chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"If I were to say that abandoning taqiyyah is like abandoning salat (prayer), I would be truthful."

key_terms.التَّقِيَّةِ: taqiyyah; precautionary dissimulation or protective concealment in circumstances of danger
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.تَارِكَ: one who abandons or leaves something

ai.seo_question: How important is taqiyyah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام declares the great seriousness of abandoning taqiyyah by comparing it to abandoning salat (prayer). The statement emphasizes taqiyyah as a matter of major religious importance in safeguarding faith and the community under circumstances requiring it.
